name: Embedded Systems & IoT
description: Programming microcontrollers close to the hardware, real-time software, and connecting devices to the cloud as IoT systems.

nodes.name: What is embedded
nodes.desc: Microcontrollers vs microprocessors, constraints and the embedded toolchain.
nodes.summary: You will be able to distinguish microcontrollers from microprocessors, describe embedded constraints and set up the embedded toolchain.

nodes.name: Microcontrollers
nodes.desc: MCU architecture, memory map, registers and dev boards.
nodes.summary: You will be able to describe MCU architecture, read its memory map and configure peripheral registers on a development board.

nodes.name: Embedded C
nodes.desc: Bit manipulation, volatile, memory-mapped registers and cross-compiling.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write embedded C that manipulates bits, accesses memory-mapped registers through volatile and cross-compiles for a target.

nodes.name: GPIO & blinky
nodes.desc: Digital input and output, pull-ups and debouncing buttons.
nodes.summary: You will be able to configure GPIO pins for digital input and output, use pull-up resistors and debounce buttons.
topics: Configuring pins as input or output

nodes.name: Timers & PWM
nodes.desc: Hardware timers, PWM for motors and LEDs, and delays without blocking.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use hardware timers for non-blocking delays and generate PWM signals to drive motors and dim LEDs.

nodes.name: Interrupts
nodes.desc: Interrupt service routines, priorities and sharing data safely with an ISR.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write interrupt service routines, set interrupt priorities and share data safely between an ISR and main code.
topics: Sharing data with volatile and atomics

nodes.name: ADC & sensors
nodes.desc: Analog-to-digital conversion, sampling and reading sensors.
nodes.summary: You will be able to read analog sensors through an ADC, choose sampling rates and convert raw readings into physical units.

nodes.name: UART, I2C & SPI
nodes.desc: Serial communication buses and talking to peripheral chips.
nodes.summary: You will be able to communicate with peripheral chips over UART, I2C and SPI and choose the right bus for a device.
topics: SPI clock modes and chip select

nodes.name: RTOS
nodes.desc: Tasks, priorities, preemptive scheduling, queues and semaphores in an RTOS.
nodes.summary: You will be able to structure firmware as RTOS tasks with priorities and coordinate them using queues and semaphores.

nodes.name: Power management
nodes.desc: Sleep modes, wake-up sources and battery budgets.
nodes.summary: You will be able to cut power consumption with sleep modes and wake-up sources and estimate battery life for a device.

nodes.name: Memory & bootloaders
nodes.desc: Flash and RAM limits, linker scripts, bootloaders and firmware updates.
nodes.summary: You will be able to fit firmware into flash and RAM using linker scripts and update devices safely through a bootloader.

nodes.name: Embedded debugging
nodes.desc: JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers and printf debugging.
nodes.summary: You will be able to debug firmware with JTAG or SWD debuggers, logic analysers and serial printf output.

nodes.name: IoT architecture
nodes.desc: Devices, gateways, cloud back ends and the edge.
nodes.summary: You will be able to describe IoT system architecture from devices and gateways to cloud back ends and edge processing.

nodes.name: MQTT & CoAP
nodes.desc: Lightweight publish/subscribe and request/response protocols for devices.
nodes.summary: You will be able to connect devices with MQTT publish-subscribe and CoAP request-response protocols.

nodes.name: BLE, Wi-Fi & LoRa
nodes.desc: Short and long range wireless options and their power and bandwidth trade-offs.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compare BLE, Wi-Fi and LoRa by range, power and bandwidth and choose one for a device.

nodes.name: IoT security
nodes.desc: Secure boot, device identity, encrypted transport and over-the-air updates.
nodes.summary: You will be able to secure IoT devices with secure boot, unique device identity, encrypted transport and signed over-the-air updates.

nodes.name: Edge & cloud
nodes.desc: Device shadows, telemetry pipelines and processing at the edge.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build telemetry pipelines with device shadows and decide what processing belongs at the edge.

nodes.name: Weather station
nodes.desc: Build a sensor node that samples the weather, sleeps between readings and publishes over MQTT.
nodes.summary: You will build a battery-powered sensor node that samples the weather, sleeps between readings and publishes data over MQTT.

nodes.name: Smart home project
nodes.desc: Build a secure smart-home controller with devices, a gateway and a dashboard.
nodes.summary: You will build a secure smart-home controller with connected devices, a gateway and a dashboard.
